lineage: Independent SAM3.1 multiplex candidate producer using the separately versioned compatibility adapter; no v9 pixel or heuristic inheritance.

output.name: candidate_human_mask
output.positive_semantics: Pixels belonging to accepted ego hand, wrist, forearm, or sleeve instances emitted by the pinned SAM3.1 model.
output.negative_semantics: All other pixels, including rejected background-person instances and the selected visible task-object SAM instance.

pixel_algebra: candidate_human_mask = union(accepted current-frame or propagated SAM3.1 human instances) AND NOT(selected current-frame or propagated SAM3.1 object instance)
selection_evidence_only: closest-image-boundary evidence derived from the ego wrist
Object6D analytic cylinder projection for selecting the task-object SAM instance
forbidden_pixel_sources: optical-flow warp used as output pixels
historical SAM2, v9, v11, or v12 masks
fail_closed: Missing ego seeds, missing valid Object6D protect evidence, missing prompt identity, insufficient seed/boundary/temporal evidence, or pixel-lineage violation yields HOLD; no fallback mask is generated.
